{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Remove them from the dataset
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Verify removal
print(f'Number of QA rows removed: {len(qa_rows)}')
print(f'New dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}')

# Check if any other revenue values are suspicious
print('Any other revenue values >= 100000?', (df_clean['revenue_clean'] >= 100000).any())"}
